note: Image slots use still screenshot/diagram; GIF slots are animated demonstrations. Both temporarily show the provided neutral PNG. The first caption is public-facing; the second is precise capture instruction.

slots.alt: Latch World Outliner with red expansion latches, yellow Mixed View and a white Keep Visible pin
slots.caption: Latch combines persistent parent expansion choices with selective paths to important descendants.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the UE 5.8 World Outliner in a deep folder hierarchy. Show one red latched-open row, one red latched-closed row, a yellow Mixed ancestor and a white pinned Actor together; keep row labels and triangle/pin glyphs legible.
slots.heading: The problem Latch solves

slots.alt: Diagram connecting the Latch editor module to subsystem, registry and row widgets
slots.caption: Latch separates saved presentation intent from live Outliner row interaction and reconciliation.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw a source-labeled diagram with FLatchModule registering the Scene Outliner label/observer columns and input processor, FRegistry reconciling UI state, and ULatchSubsystem holding per-project expansion/pin/suspend data.
slots.heading: Module architecture

slots.alt: Latch plugin installed under an Unreal Engine project's Plugins directory
slots.caption: A project installation puts the Latch descriptor and plugin files inside the project's Plugins/Latch folder.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Windows File Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Latch, with the address bar and Latch.uplugin, Source, Resources and Config visible. Avoid showing a nested double-Latch folder or unrelated plugins.
slots.heading: Project installation

slots.alt: Animation of the first expansion latch, Keep Visible pin and resulting Mixed View
slots.caption: The first-use workflow moves from a normal expander to a red latch and then a pinned descendant exposed through a yellow parent.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a compact Unreal Editor sequence with one folder and children: expand, Alt-click to turn red, unlatch, pin a child using the white pin, collapse the ancestor and show its yellow Mixed triangle. Display mouse modifier labels unobtrusively.
slots.heading: Try Latch on a test hierarchy

slots.alt: Diagram of mouse gestures routed to Latch's input processor and registry
slots.caption: Normal, Alt and Shift expansion interactions take separate paths through Latch and the native Outliner.
slots.capture_instructions: Illustrate a flow from native Outliner expander hit testing through FInputProcessor to normal click, Alt-click ToggleLatch and Shift-click recursive expansion. Show pin clicks separately through SKeepVisiblePin and FRegistry.
slots.heading: Input dispatch

slots.alt: Comparison of normal, latched-open and latched-closed expansion triangles
slots.caption: Grey triangles follow normal Outliner expansion, while red triangles hold their parent's chosen open or closed state.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture three representative parent rows in the same Unreal Outliner: unlocked grey, red latched-expanded with children showing, and red latched-collapsed with children hidden. Include labels naming each state.
slots.heading: Three expansion modes

slots.alt: Animation of Alt-clicking a parent to latch it and attempting ordinary expansion changes
slots.caption: An expansion latch resists normal clicks until Alt-click removes its protected state.
slots.capture_instructions: Record Alt-clicking an expanded parent into red, clicking normally without collapsing it, Alt-clicking again to unlatch, then demonstrating the same interaction on a collapsed parent. Keep the triangle and row text in frame.
slots.heading: What a red latch protects

slots.alt: Diagram of Unlatched, LatchedOpen and LatchedClosed subsystem values
slots.caption: Latch records expansion intent as one of three stored states rather than saving physical tree row visibility.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw the ELatchExpansionState enum as Unlatched, LatchedOpen and LatchedClosed, linked to a saved item key in ULatchSubsystem. Separate the saved state from current STreeView physical expansion.
slots.heading: Stored state

slots.alt: Animation revealing the minimum path to a selected Actor inside collapsed ancestors
slots.caption: Yellow Mixed View exposes only the ancestor rows needed for a selected or pinned descendant, leaving unrelated siblings collapsed.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a deeply nested Actor C beneath Folder/Actor A/Actor B with the ancestors collapsed; select C from the viewport and show the yellow path appearing while unrelated sibling rows remain hidden. Deselect or unpin to show the path reversing.
slots.heading: Why a yellow triangle appears

slots.alt: Animation of clicking a yellow Mixed triangle to commit a normal expansion
slots.caption: Clicking a Mixed ancestor changes the logical branch to fully expanded instead of collapsing the temporary exposure path.
slots.capture_instructions: Start with a yellow ancestor exposing one pinned child. Click its yellow triangle once and show all regular children expanding; the indicator becomes grey if no other Mixed condition remains. Keep the same Outliner framing.
slots.heading: What clicking yellow does

slots.alt: Diagram contrasting a logically collapsed branch with its physically visible Mixed View bridge
slots.caption: Latch preserves logical collapse while temporarily expanding a physical path to a required descendant.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw side-by-side logical hierarchy and physical STreeView representation: collapsed flag false for an ancestor, an exposed required descendant path, suppressed siblings, and FOutlinerRuntime ForcedPhysicalExpansion preserving the original logical value.
slots.heading: Logical/physical split

slots.alt: Comparison of hidden inactive pin slot and enabled white Keep Visible pin
slots.caption: Keep Visible reserves a stable slot beside Actor and Folder labels and keeps enabled pins visible.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture two eligible World Outliner rows: the first with a hovered grey inactive pin in its reserved slot and the second with a white active pin. Show the normal Actor/Folder icons and unchanged label alignment.
slots.heading: Pin a row, not an Actor's render visibility

slots.alt: Diagram of an item identity key persisting while its hierarchy position changes
slots.caption: A Keep Visible key belongs to an Actor or Folder identity, not the row's current screen position.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram the same Actor GUID/world package identity moving from Folder A to Folder B while its KeepVisible key remains in ULatchSubsystem. Show the Outliner row being recreated without changing the pin's logical state.
slots.heading: Data ownership

slots.alt: Animation of recursive Shift-click respecting red latched child folders
slots.caption: Recursive expansion changes unlocked descendants but preserves the intended expansion of red latched children.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a parent folder with at least three nested child folders, one red-open and one red-closed. Shift-click the unlocked parent to collapse and expand; show the red children retaining their protected logical states.
slots.heading: Shift-click expands or collapses a branch

slots.alt: Flowchart of recursive expansion skipping children with saved latch states
slots.caption: Recursive actions follow the real Outliner tree and protect descendants that already have expansion latches.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw FRegistry HandleRecursiveExpanderClick walking the live tree, checking ULatchSubsystem expansion state, applying changes only to unlocked descendants and requesting reconciliation afterward.
slots.heading: Native hierarchy interaction

slots.alt: Animation of Alt-clicking one selected parent to latch several selected parents
slots.caption: A selected parent determines the batch's expansion-latch intent while childless selected rows are ignored.
slots.capture_instructions: Record three selected folders with children plus one selected leaf Actor. Alt-click the expansion triangle on one selected folder, show red states applied to eligible parents and the leaf unchanged, then Alt-click again to remove the latches.
slots.heading: Expansion batch

slots.alt: Animation of batch pin toggling on a mixed Outliner selection
slots.caption: A Keep Visible batch enables all eligible pins when any are unpinned, and disables them when all are pinned.
slots.capture_instructions: Select three Actors with only one white pin active. Click the pin of a selected row to make all white, then click again to clear all pins. Keep selection highlighting and the pin states clearly visible.
slots.heading: Keep Visible batch

slots.alt: Diagram showing clicked-row membership determining batch action scope
slots.caption: Latch applies direct-control gestures to the active selection only when the clicked row is itself selected.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw two paths: clicked row belongs to the selected item IDs → batch eligible items, and clicked row is not selected → only clicked item. Annotate parent-only latch and Actor/Folder pin eligibility.
slots.heading: Target resolution

slots.alt: World Outliner context menu showing Latch's available hierarchy actions
slots.caption: The Latch submenu exposes explicit expansion, pin, branch-clearing and suspension commands.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a right-click on a parent folder in the World Outliner with the Latch submenu open; show Latch Current Expansion, Latch Expanded/Collapsed, Unlatch, Keep Visible, branch clear, Suspend and global clear options if present in the current UI.
slots.heading: Where the commands live

slots.alt: Diagram of native Scene Outliner menu extension and live item resolution
slots.caption: Latch adds commands to Unreal's existing menu and resolves selected tree items at execution time.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw FLatchModule's native Outliner menu modifier, Latch submenu, selected tree item IDs, FRegistry ResolveLiveItems and PopulateContextMenu. Separate actor and folder eligibility checks.
slots.heading: Menu integration
Use Latch without returning to the Outliner
slots.alt: Latch commands in the viewport's context menu
slots.caption: Selected Actors can access Latch presentation controls directly from the Level Editor viewport.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a selected Actor in the Level Editor viewport with the native right-click menu open to its Latch submenu. Include the selected Actor's Outliner row in the editor layout if possible, but do not imply folders are viewport-selected.

slots.heading: What happens on clearing search?
slots.alt: Animation of World Outliner search temporarily changing hierarchy presentation and restoring Latch state
slots.caption: Search can reveal matching rows without permanently replacing the saved expansion and Keep Visible choices.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a red latched-closed folder and white pinned descendant, then type a search for an unrelated Actor, inspect results, and clear the search. Show the red and white state returning and the correct yellow paths recalculating.

slots.heading: Detection
slots.alt: Diagram of capturing logical expansion before Outliner search and restoring afterward
slots.caption: Latch preserves a pre-search logical expansion snapshot while Unreal controls the temporary search presentation.
slots.capture_instructions: Make a three-stage flowchart labeled Search Starts / Search Active / Search Clears. Show Runtime SearchLogicalExpansion, PresentInactive and restoration plus Mixed View recalculation; avoid depicting search as modifying persisted red/white state.

slots.heading: Temporary normal Unreal behavior
slots.alt: Animation of suspending Latch and resuming stored expansion presentation
slots.caption: Suspending Latch temporarily returns the Outliner to native behavior while retaining recorded latches and pins.
slots.capture_instructions: Record an Outliner with red latches and a yellow Mixed ancestor, invoke Suspend Latch from the menu, demonstrate ordinary expansion, then invoke Resume Latch and show the stored red/white states and required yellow paths restored.

slots.heading: Stored flag
slots.alt: Diagram separating the suspended boolean from stored expansion and Keep Visible keys
slots.caption: Suspension changes reconciliation behavior without deleting previously saved item state.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw ULatchSubsystem with independent Expansion, KeepVisible and Suspended fields; show FRegistry choosing either the inactive/native presentation branch or normal latch reconciliation depending on Suspended.

slots.heading: Settings class
slots.alt: Diagram distinguishing Latch Project Settings from per-project editor state
slots.caption: Appearance preferences live in Latch configuration, while saved item latches and pins live in editor workspace configuration.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram ULatchSettings reading Config/DefaultLatch.ini and ULatchSubsystem saving section Latch.State.V3 to GEditorPerProjectIni. Label spacing/color/hover/persist preference separately from per-item expansion, pin and Suspend state.

slots.heading: When persistence is disabled
slots.alt: Animation of disabling persistence, arranging a hierarchy and observing a clean restart
slots.caption: Latch can retain a temporary workspace arrangement for the active editor session without saving it for the next launch.
slots.capture_instructions: Record Project Settings with Persist State Across Editor Restarts unchecked, then set a red latch and white pin, close/reopen a disposable project and show those temporary states absent. Make clear that the level itself was not changed.

slots.heading: Config storage
slots.alt: Diagram of Latch.State.V3 expansion, KeepVisible and Suspended records
slots.caption: Latch stores stable keyed expansion and pin information in per-project editor configuration rather than level packages.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a technical diagram showing Section Latch.State.V3 with Expansion array, KeepVisible array, and Suspended boolean written to GEditorPerProjectIni; distinguish it from .umap and external Actor .uasset packages.

slots.heading: Keep Visible follows the item
slots.alt: Animation moving a pinned Actor between folders while retaining its pin
slots.caption: Keep Visible remains associated with the Actor's identity when it is moved or reparented in the Outliner.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a white-pinned Actor in Folder A, drag it to Folder B or attach it under another Actor, then collapse the new ancestor and show its white pin and required Mixed path still functioning. Include both before and after states.

slots.heading: Identity implementation
slots.alt: Diagram of Actor GUID and Folder GUID/path identity keys
slots.caption: Latch associates editor presentation state with stable Actor or Folder identifiers when available.
slots.capture_instructions: Create an example of Actor|WorldPackage|GUID, FolderGuid|WorldPackage|GUID, and the fallback ActorPath/FolderPath key families. Show those keys mapping to expansion and pin state inside ULatchSubsystem.

slots.heading: Clear only what you intend
slots.alt: Animation clearing Latch state from one branch while other branches retain their state
slots.caption: Branch clearing removes selected hierarchy presentation settings without deleting any Actors or Folders.
slots.capture_instructions: Record two folders with red latches and white pins, use Clear Latch State in Branch on one, and show the other folder's states remaining untouched. Avoid mixing this with native Unreal delete.

slots.heading: Project Settings utility
slots.alt: Latch Project Settings showing the Clear Saved Latch State utility
slots.caption: The saved-state utility resets persisted Latch workspace information without modifying the scene.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Project Settings > Plugins > Latch with Clear Saved Latch State visible. If a confirmation dialog appears, show it alongside the utility and make its scope readable.

slots.heading: Three responsibilities
slots.alt: Simple diagram explaining how Latch stores intent and updates World Outliner presentation
slots.caption: The subsystem stores workspace choices, the registry reconciles hierarchy state, and row widgets display the result.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw three labeled blocks: ULatchSubsystem Saved Intent → FRegistry Hierarchy Reconciliation → World Outliner Rows/Controls. Include a selection/pin event input and illustrate that the actual level hierarchy is unchanged.

slots.heading: Module startup and shutdown
slots.alt: Technical architecture diagram of Latch's editor integration components
slots.caption: Latch integrates the Editor module, subsystem, Scene Outliner columns, Slate input processor and menu extensions.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a source-class diagram naming FLatchModule, ULatchSubsystem, FRegistry, FObserverColumn, SKeepVisiblePin, FInputProcessor, UToolMenus and STreeView. Use distinct arrows for registration, keyed data reads, invalidation and row presentation.

slots.heading: A demanding workflow to test
slots.alt: Animation of Latch maintaining a large Outliner during scrolling, selection and search
slots.caption: Latch's event-driven hierarchy updates are designed to avoid continuous full-tree work during ordinary row interaction.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a realistically large UE Outliner with many nested folders: scroll, pin an item, select a viewport Actor, search and clear, then resume. Include an FPS/stat overlay only if measured honestly and don't invent a performance comparison.

slots.heading: Event-driven scheduling
slots.alt: Diagram of event-driven invalidation and slower fallback reconciliation
slots.caption: Latch coalesces hierarchy updates triggered by editor events and retains a separate slow safety audit for otherwise unannounced changes.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw selection/Actor/hierarchy/row lifecycle events feeding FRegistry Invalidate and scheduled Tick/UpdateOutliner. Add the 3-second fallback audit as a distinct low-frequency safety path, not the normal response latency.

slots.heading: Why are ancestors yellow?
slots.alt: Comparison of a normal collapsed folder and a yellow Mixed View ancestor
slots.caption: A yellow ancestor is logically collapsed but temporarily exposes the necessary path to a selected or pinned descendant.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture two nearby nested folders in the Outliner: one ordinary grey collapsed, the other yellow showing only a pinned or selected child path. Include a visible white pin or selection highlight to explain the exposure requirement.

slots.heading: Symptom-to-owner map
slots.alt: Diagnostic flowchart for Latch missing controls, state and refresh issues
slots.caption: Diagnosing Latch begins by identifying whether the issue involves UI registration, keyed persistence or live row reconciliation.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a branching diagram with symptom groups Column/Menu Missing → FLatchModule, State Lost → ULatchSubsystem, Yellow Path Wrong → FRegistry MixedItems, Input Gesture Wrong → FInputProcessor, Search Restore Wrong → SearchLogicalExpansion.

slots.heading: Updating a precompiled installation
slots.alt: Latch plugin directory in a project's Plugins folder after an update
slots.caption: Replacing the complete Latch folder avoids mixing source and binary files from incompatible releases.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Windows File Explorer showing YourProject/Plugins/Latch with Latch.uplugin directly inside and Source/Resources/Config beneath it. Include a clear version reference for the downloaded release and exclude irrelevant project folders.

slots.heading: Where Latch is today
slots.alt: Timeline separating Latch v2.0.3 features from uncommitted future research
slots.caption: The current release supports hierarchy latches, Mixed View, pins and editor persistence; future ideas have not been assigned a release.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a clean timeline showing Current: Latch v2.0.3 with expansion, Mixed View, Keep Visible and persistence. Show Future Review as explicitly uncommitted, containing compatibility, usability, performance and testing, without an invented v3.0 milestone.
